subject: Calibration: Senior Infrastructure Engineer interview panel & leveling
messages:
From: Sara Recruiting <sara_recruiting@talentsea.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Interview scheduling - Alex Jenkins

Hi Tessa/Laura (and Markus),

Hope you're both well. Quick intro: Alex Jenkins is a strong candidate for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role. He's available for a 90-minute on-site style loop next week (Wed/Thu mornings PST). Can you confirm availability for a panel on Wednesday 28th 10:00-11:30am PT? We'd like Tessa to lead the system-design portion and Markus to cover scaling/ops.

Alex's short profile: 10y infra, previously SRE lead at Nimbus, k8s + multi-region rollout experience. Resume attached (sent separately).

Thanks — I'll hold the slot tentatively.

—Sara
Senior Recruiter, TalentSea

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-05-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling - Alex Jenkins

Thanks Sara — Wed 28th 10:00 works for me.

Laura/Markus/Dev — I've started a short calibration doc attached (senior_infra_calibration_notes.pdf). Key asks:
- Leveling: hire at Senior (IC4) vs Staff (IC5) boundaries — please review the bullets around "scope & ownership" and give a thumbs up / suggested changes.
- Interview focus: system architecture (30m), scaling incident post-mortem (30m), team fit & execution (20m), deep dive on migrations (10m).
- Bar-raiser checklist: safety/rollback thinking, fault-injection reasoning, measurable tradeoffs.

Please add quick comments inline; I'll merge and share with Sara so panel is aligned.

Tessa Morgan
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — quick thoughts inline: 
- Leveling: emphasize cross-team influence and measurable org impact for IC5. If candidate's migrations were limited to a single service, that likely maps to IC4.
- Bar-raiser: add a quick exercise on cost/complexity tradeoffs for multi-region rollouts (5-10m).
- Interview scoring: use the attached sample_debrief_template.md so we can capture signals consistently (I've filled the scoring buckets).

I'll handle the scaling/ops deep dive and hit the failure-injection question.

-Markus
Director, Production Engineering
Redwood Inference

Sounds good. I'll take team fit / execution and evaluate collaboration examples + leadership potential.

One quick ask: can we agree on the "must have" signals for Senior vs Staff? I propose:
- Senior: owns services end-to-end, writes runbooks, leads small cross-functional projects
- Staff: shapes architecture across services, drives adoption of major infra patterns, mentors at scale

If that's OK I'll mirror the language in the debrief template.

—Laura
